notes: Root cause was NOT a Lean compile error (the library already builds: `lake build GrokRxiv.Paper` -> 8480 jobs). It was a manifest-shape mismatch: the validator (orchestrator lean_audit.rs::manifest_has_source_backed_interface) reads parsed library_manifest.json and requires manifest["declarations"] to be an array containing >=1 entry with kind == "interface" AND a NON-EMPTY ARRAY source_evidence. The prior manifest only had `opaque_interfaces` with `source_evidence` as a string, so no source-backed interface was found -> opaque_missing_source_evidence.

Fix: added a top-level `declarations` array mapping every one of the 14 `opaque` declarations in GrokRxiv/Paper/Interfaces.lean (SchemeCarrier, IsoOverBase, SchProd, HasSmoothPoint, IsGoodCStarUnique, CStarIso, bpVariety, AnGermCarrier, FormalGermCarrier, bpAnGerm, bpFormalGerm, BiholAn, BiholFormal, FormalRingIso) to an entry with kind="interface" and an array-valued `source_evidence` carrying the LaTeX source citation(s). The original `opaque_interfaces`/`concrete_declarations` blocks are retained for human readability.

No Lean files were edited; no sorry/admit/axiom introduced. Bodyless opaques landing in Nonempty-carrier types (Sch/AnGerm/FormalGerm) remain `noncomputable opaque` with dependent type defs `noncomputable`, per the rules.
Verified post-edit: library_manifest.json parses and 14/14 declarations are kind="interface" with non-empty source_evidence arrays, so the require_source_evidence_for_opaque check now passes.

Source/library gap unchanged and still reported (not a claim change): Theorem C(2)'s formal-completion ring iso (\hat B_a = C[[X]]/(f_a)) stays modelled as the opaque relation FormalRingIso because the MvPowerSeries quotient algebra and its C-algebra isomorphisms are not available in usable form in Mathlib; the analytic/formal germ layer is likewise irreducibly opaque.
